ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey), with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 5% of the total visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous solid dark-pigment field. High-contrast white punctate blobs are scattered across the right lobe. A distinct, high-intensity mottled patch is mapped to the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe edge exhibits low-frequency micro-irregularities. The right lobe trailing edge displays a higher frequency of serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 10 pixels, isolated clearly against the lighter background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve extending from the median notch, transitioning into a convex curve as the trajectory approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 10-15 small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized predominantly on the right lobe's ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal linear pixel disruption is visible in the upper-medial region of the right lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe features a large, irregular region of high-relief, brownish-grey texture and pigment loss, indicating major localized physical trauma or significant parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized high-contrast white mottled pattern concentrated specifically at the extreme point of the right lobe tip.
